sentences.text: For thousands of years, donkeys have been critical for propelling human civilizations forward.
sentences.read: For thousands of years, donkeys have been critical for propelling human civilizations forward.

sentences.text: They’ve helped pull wheeled vehicles, carry travelers and move goods across the world.
sentences.read: They've helped pull wheeled vehicles, carry travelers and move goods across the world.

sentences.text: But where and when these animals first became intertwined with humans has been a mystery.
sentences.read: But where and when these animals first became intertwined with humans has been a mystery.

sentences.text: Now, researchers have used genomes of over 200 donkeys to trace their domestication back to a single event around 7,000 years ago in East Africa—about 3,000 years before humans tamed horses.
sentences.read: Now, researchers have used genomes of over two hundred donkeys to trace their domestication back to a single event around seven thousand years ago in East Africa—about three thousand years before humans tamed horses.

sentences.text: The team published their findings in the journal Science this month.
sentences.read: The team published their findings in the journal Science this month.

sentences.text: “Through their DNA, the animals are telling their history themselves,” co-author Samantha Brooks, an equine researcher at the University of Florida, says in a statement.
sentences.read: “Through their DNA, the animals are telling their history themselves” co-author Samantha Brooks, an equine researcher at the University of Florida, says in a statement.

sentences.text: “We usually only get the human’s side of history through written accounts, but of course written history does not always record exactly how something happened.
sentences.read: “We usually only get the human's side of history through written accounts, but of course written history does not always record exactly how something happened.

sentences.text: Looking at these DNA sequences, we get a biological testimony to the environment these animals lived in and the experiences they survived.”
sentences.read: Looking at these DNA sequences, we get a biological testimony to the environment these animals lived in and the experiences they survived.”

sentences.text: The researchers examined 207 genomes from modern donkeys living in 31 countries across the globe.
sentences.read: The researchers examined two hundred seven genomes from modern donkeys living in thirty-one countries across the globe.

sentences.text: They also looked at genomes from 15 wild equids and 31 earlier donkeys that lived between about 4,000 and 100 years ago.
sentences.read: They also looked at genomes from fifteen wild equids and thirty-one earlier donkeys that lived between about four thousand and one hundred years ago.

sentences.text: The team reconstructed the animals’ evolutionary tree and used computer models to pinpoint the domestication event when herders in Kenya and the Horn of Africa tamed wild asses.
sentences.read: The team reconstructed the animals' evolutionary tree and used computer models to pinpoint the domestication event when herders in Kenya and the Horn of Africa tamed wild asses.

sentences.text: They then traced how the animals spread across the rest of the continent into Europe and Asia about 2,500 years later.
sentences.read: They then traced how the animals spread across the rest of the continent into Europe and Asia about two thousand five hundred years later.

sentences.text: Though it’s still unclear why the original domestication happened, Science News’ Freda Kreier reports that the event coincided with the Sahara growing larger and drier.
sentences.read: Though it's still unclear why the original domestication happened, Science News' Freda Kreier reports that the event coincided with the Sahara growing larger and drier.

sentences.text: “Donkeys are champions when it comes to carrying stuff and are good at going through deserts,” co-author Ludovic Orlando, an evolutionary biologist at Paul Sabatier University in France, tells the publication.
sentences.read: “Donkeys are champions when it comes to carrying stuff and are good at going through deserts” co-author Ludovic Orlando, an evolutionary biologist at Paul Sabatier University in France, tells the publication.

sentences.text: Prehistoric humans may have tamed donkeys to help navigate the expanding Sahara.

sentences.text: Researchers say these findings could help put donkeys in the spotlight.

sentences.text: The animals could benefit from more research: Currently, there are no published genomes from donkeys located south of the Equator in Africa.

sentences.text: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.

sentences.text: Not only does understanding the equines’ genetic makeup help reveal their contribution to human history, but it also might improve their management in the future, as climate change alters the planet’s environment, write the authors.
